about: The clip queue. The daily run takes the first jobs with status "todo" (about 5 to 8 a day on the free allowance). To add a job, copy one and change it; see clips/README.md. The free allowance is charged by the length asked for (a 5 s clip reserves about 90 s of GPU; about 4.5 min a day free), so keep clips short: 3 s for loops and small moves.

jobs.uses: Level 4: the Interpreter lifts his open hand as he explains (in the game since build 278, assets/room-interpreter-say.webp)
jobs.prompt: (see the session record)

jobs.uses: Level 4: the candle-lit passage between rooms, the door, leaving; any later level where he walks
jobs.prompt: An old grave kind man in a long red-brown gown and a dark skull-cap walks slowly and steadily to the RIGHT, his hands folded in front of him, an unhurried dignified walk. The camera moves along with him and does NOT zoom: he stays in the centre of the frame at exactly the same size, his whole body always visible; he walks on the spot in the frame with even, regular steps, so the walk can loop.
jobs.check: Good: walks on the spot, camera still, even steps, loops. Feet level.

jobs.uses: Level 4: the passage and leaving in the painted manner; later painted rooms (Palace Beautiful, Level 7)
jobs.prompt: A pilgrim in a worn hooded cloak with a great bundle tied with rope on his back walks slowly and steadily to the RIGHT, bent a little under the weight, his hands empty. The camera moves along with him and does NOT zoom: he stays in the centre of the frame at exactly the same size, his whole body always visible; he walks on the spot in the frame with even, regular steps, so the walk can loop.
jobs.check: Good: steady walk on the spot, hood and burden kept, camera still.

jobs.uses: Level 4 room 2: the damsel pours and the sweeper sweeps, laid back into the still painting
jobs.prompt: The young woman slowly pours a thin stream of water from her red-brown jug onto the floor, and the man beside her slowly sweeps the floor with his broom; fine dust drifts in the window light. The camera is completely still: no zoom, no pan, no cut. Only the people and the light move; the room, the walls and every object stay exactly where they are. Keep the oil-painting style and colours exactly.
jobs.check: First half good (pouring, sweeping); about 2.5 s in the model cut to another view of the room: use only frames 0 to about 40.

jobs.uses: Level 4 room 2: the man sweeps (looped), laid back into the painting where his arms and broom move; again after the water, with no dust; any later sweeping
jobs.negative: camera movement, zoom, pan, cut, scene change, new view, extra limbs, extra people, text, watermark, fast motion, morphing, changing walls, flicker
jobs.prompt: An oil painting comes to life. The young man in the brown jerkin sweeps the wooden floor in front of him with his straw broom: slow, short, steady strokes to and fro, his feet planted, his body still, only his arms and the broom moving, and at the end the broom is back where it began. The young woman with the jug at the left edge does not move at all. One single continuous shot: the camera is completely still, no zoom, no pan, no cut. The wall, the tiles, the floor and the light stay exactly as they are. Keep the oil-painting style and colours exactly.
jobs.check: Good: he sweeps with short strokes and the broom comes back to where it began (loops); camera still; the girl at the left edge moves a little, so only his side is used. In the game since build 364.

jobs.uses: Level 4 room 2: played BACKWARDS, the damsel lifts and tips her jug to sprinkle the room; its last frame is her standing by with the jug still
jobs.negative: camera movement, zoom, pan, cut, scene change, new view, extra limbs, extra people, text, watermark, fast motion, morphing, changing walls, flicker
jobs.prompt: An oil painting comes to life. The young woman slowly stops pouring: she tips the red-brown jug upright, lowers it gently and holds it still in both hands in front of her waist, then stands quietly. She stays in the same place; her feet do not move. The man at the right edge does not move at all. One single continuous shot: the camera is completely still, no zoom, no pan, no cut. The wall, the tiles, the floor and the light stay exactly as they are. Keep the oil-painting style and colours exactly.
jobs.check: Frames 0 to 14 good: she brings the jug from pouring to upright, in profile. After about frame 16 she turns to face us: not used. In the game (played backwards for the pour) since build 364.

jobs.uses: Level 4: the Interpreter (the dark repainted figure of build 351) lifts his open hand as he explains and folds his hands again; replaces the switched-off gesture; drawn large so the face is sharp
jobs.prompt: The old man with a grey beard and a dark skull-cap, his hands folded, speaks gently and kindly as he explains: he slowly lifts one open hand in front of him, palm up, his lips moving as he talks, then slowly folds his hands again as at the start. He stands still on the spot, both feet planted.
jobs.check: Good: the new dark Interpreter lifts an open hand and folds his hands again, feet planted, side view, camera still. Can replace the switched-off gesture.

jobs.uses: Level 4 gate: Good-will reaches out with both hands to pull Christian in (the father's hands in Rembrandt's Prodigal Son); played back, he folds his hands again
jobs.prompt: An old bare-headed man with a short white beard and a long gown and cloak, his hands folded, leans forward and reaches out low with both hands, warmly, as if to take hold of someone and draw them in.
jobs.check: Good: Good-will leans forward and reaches out with both hands, side view, feet level, camera still.

jobs.uses: Level 4 room 7: the man risen from his bed trembles and stares up in awe
jobs.prompt: The man sitting up in the curtained bed trembles, breathing hard, staring up in awe and fear; his hand grips the bedclothes; the curtains stir very slightly. The camera is completely still: no zoom, no pan, no cut. Only the people and the light move; the room, the walls and every object stay exactly where they are. Keep the oil-painting style and colours exactly. ONE single continuous shot from beginning to end: it never cuts, never changes to another view or another room.
jobs.check: Good: the man in bed stares up, mouth opening in awe; camera still, room kept.

jobs.uses: Level 4 room 5: the brave man striding through the guards (a loop)
jobs.prompt: A man in a steel helmet and breastplate, sword drawn, strides steadily and boldly to the RIGHT. jobs.check: Mostly good: the man throws water, the fire burns, the man behind the wall pours oil; at the end the water man changes his pose with the bucket a little abruptly; check before use.
